structure.unit: Requirements Applicable to Underground Coal Mines; Electricity, Safety, Etc
Ventilation, Mine Gases, and Other Hazardous Conditions

law.catch_line: Allowing persons to work in mine where methane monitoring equipment disconnected; penalty
law.text: No operator, agent, or mine foreman shall knowingly permit any miner to work in any area of an underground coal mine where such operator, agent, or mine foreman has knowledge that a methane monitor or other device capable of detecting the presence of explosive gas has been impaired, disturbed, disconnected, or bypassed in violation of § 45.2-848. Violation of this section is a Class 6 felony.
